outlook.statement: Efforts are being taken to reduce costs & improve operating margins. With past track record of the company and the anticipated political stability and thrust to infrastructure development is expected to revive road transport business and enhance business volumes.

To cut down on downtime costs, the company has reduced the size of its fleet, new business vertical of warehouse management services has been initiated and the company is hopeful of adding more clients in this vertical.

Increasing formalization of logistics and warehousing operations, growth in organized distribution networks and increasing focus on integrated supply chain solutions provide long-term growth opportunities
Focus on strengthening presence in integrated logistics, warehousing and allied supply chain services while maintaining operational discipline and financial prudence
Evaluating opportunities in organized warehousing, technology-enabled supply chain operations, material handling systems, and value-added supply chain services
